title: IntelligentTieringConfiguration

Id.description: The ID used to identify the S3 Intelligent-Tiering configuration.

Filter.description: Specifies a bucket filter. The configuration only includes objects that meet the filter's criteria.

Tierings.description: Specifies the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class tier of the configuration.

description:
Specifies the S3 Intelligent-Tiering configuration for an Amazon S3 bucket.

For information about the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class, see Storage class for automatically optimizing frequently and infrequently accessed objects.
